miko: Quick design check-in: two related things for the Dataset Import modal — 1) where to surface hints vs inline error messages, 2) deletion flows: keep typed-confirm for big deletes or use inline undo for row deletes? jamal: For hints, I prefer persistent helper text under the label for format/examples. Inline error only after a validation event (blur or submit) so we don't distract while typing. :+1: sara: Agree on persistent hints. Regarding required fields: asterisk alone isn't accessible. We should render a visual asterisk but also set aria-required="true" and include visible text for screen readers when helpful. laura: Example implementation idea:
CSV or JSON, max 200MB
— that pairs visual and SR hints. ethan: When should inline errors appear? on blur or after submit? I'm cautious about showing red error states mid-typing. miko: Proposal: show non-blocking format hints on blur (e.g., "Looks like a malformed CSV") and reserve blocking errors until submit. Use a subtle fade-in animation to reduce startle. jamal: Also keep error copy terse and actionable: "Use a valid email" vs helper text being explanatory: "We will email import reports to this address." laura: On destructive actions: typed-confirm is good for dataset-level irreversible deletions. For single-row deletes in tables, use a confirmation modal + undo snackbar, or even inline mini-confirm with undo. Typed-confirm for heavy ops only. sara: Let's capture a risk-tier mapping in the patterns doc: low = inline confirm + undo; medium = modal confirm with checkbox ("I understand"); high = typed-confirm. Makes decisions repeatable. ethan: Edge case: legal/regulatory deletes that are irreversible should always escalate to typed-confirm, even for single items. We need an API flag like sensitiveDeletion: true so the UI knows to force typed-confirm. miko: Good. I'll ask backend to add sensitiveDeletion flag. design-bot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/import-modal-v3 — please review the variant with helper text + aria examples. jamal: Accessibility nit: avoid more than two lines of helper copy under a control in narrow modals. If longer, add a "Learn more" link opening a side sheet. laura: Also focus behavior in modals: trap focus, move focus into the dialog but do not auto-focus the destructive confirm button to avoid accidental enters. Put focus on the cancel button or a neutral control. sara: Copy tweak for typed-confirm prompt: use explicit phrasing: "Enter the dataset name to permanently delete \"my-dataset\"." Bold the dataset name and be explicit about permanence. miko: Action list: jamal/laura update Figma with aria-describedby + helper variants; ethan add sensitiveDeletion to delete API; sara write risk-tier bullets for the patterns doc; miko consolidate microcopy guidelines and inline vs helper examples. jamal: I'll prototype the undo toast for row deletes and post screenshots later today. ethan: I'll add the flag in the API PR and link it here when ready. laura: I'll add keyboard focus notes to the modal component doc, including example code for not auto-focusing confirm. miko: Thanks all. If no objections I'll fold these into the validation patterns doc and call for review. :thumbsup:
